games.name: Innovation Inc. Spaceship
games.desc:
Further than any man or machine has ever been, flies the futuristic Innovation Inc Spaceship. Sent centuries ago to explore the secrets of the universe, this ship holds mysteries and dangers beyond imagination. This spacecraft has the most advanced technologies, such as the ability to hyperjump faster than light and a reactor core that is an almost infinite energy source. Explore the ship, do experiments on each other, get infected, travel through space and survive on alien planets!

💥 Explode the reactor core, or save it!
🧪 Experiment on yourself and others (it might go horribly wrong)!
🧟 Become a zombie and infect your friends!
🌌 Fly through space and crash on alien planets!
🛑 Only the strongest survive. Will you make it?

👑 Private server owners get admin commands!

🖥️ Play on PC, mobile, consoles and VR

Security rules don't apply.

games.name: Rusty Plane
games.desc:
Rusty Plane is a chaotic, co-op survival game where everything will go wrong, and that’s the fun of it. You and up to 5 other players must keep a falling-apart plane in the sky by fixing holes, repairing lights and pipes, regaining control, refueling, and re-oxygenating the cabin, all while chaos unfolds around you. Choose from 19 unique classes, each with their own special abilities, and see how long you can survive the madness.

Inspired by My Rusty Submarine
Game is currently in a Public-Beta stage, meaning the game isn't fully finished, so expect small bugs.
This game gets updated almost everyday and bugs are always fixed within a short amount of time. You can report bugs/players or give suggestions using the games feedback system.
If this game causes the end of your friendship, it is not my fault, remember, it's just a game.
